subject.title: feat: expose ClawHub catalog feed lanes

question: Should ClawHub expose these root feed lanes only through the stored publication feed contract with distinct feed identities, or may this PR define a new live-query root feed contract with reviewed/attestation semantics?
rationale: The change creates a new public API and client trust surface; automation can identify the contract conflict but cannot decide the permanent feed identity, review criteria, or delivery model for maintainers.

options.title: Require Stored Root Publications
options.body: Move the root lanes onto `catalogFeedPublications` or an equivalent cached snapshot path, use distinct feed IDs, and land only after generated contracts and live proof are present.

options.title: Approve Live Root Feeds
options.body: Accept the live digest-query delivery model and explicitly document the operational, trust, and compatibility boundary before merge.

options.title: Pause The Feed Stack
options.body: Keep the draft paused until the cross-repository feed RFC and OpenClaw consumer contract are ready to anchor ClawHub producer behavior.

recommendation.title: Require Stored Root Publications
recommendation.body: Move the root lanes onto `catalogFeedPublications` or an equivalent cached snapshot path, use distinct feed IDs, and land only after generated contracts and live proof are present.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the hosted feed publication path and is the strongest history signal for the delivery-contract decision.
